title: Latest reported figures: 1,114 confirmed dead
body: These figures are read automatically from the published reports as they appear, and are not written or checked by hand. confirmed dead: 1,114, up from 768, reported by Onlinekhabar. listed missing: 3,916, up from 2,502, reported by NDTV.
Where a report describes one district or one stretch of river rather than the national figure, it is not used here. Out of contact does not mean dead.
